issues: Fanfare condition is encoded incorrectly: source says "if there are 2 iM@S CG followers or less on your field," but parsed uses fieldTraitMin count 2 (at least 2). It should check 2 or fewer iM@S CG followers on your field; this needs an engine condition for a field trait maximum/count-at-most condition.

Missing continuous clause from fanfare result: after engaging itself, "This card doesn't refresh during your start phase" should also be encoded. This needs engine support for a passive self refresh restriction / skip self refresh during your start phase.

Start-of-main ability cost is encoded with optionalCost incorrectly. The source is a mandatory activated payment at that timing, "At the start of your main phase, [cost02]: Refresh this card." It should be represented as a startOfMain triggered optional payment of 2 PP to refresh this card; this needs engine support for triggered abilities with PP payment choices, or optionalCost should accept PP costs.

Passive cost reduction is missing the named-follower condition. It should only apply if there is a Gilnelise, Omen of Craving on your field, so add condition type namedFollowerOnFieldByName with identityName "Gilnelise, Omen of Craving" alongside the EX area condition.
Passive cost reduction should use exAreaPlayCostReduction rather than generic playCostReduction, because the source says this card costs 3 less to play from the EX area.

On Evolve buff target is encoded incorrectly. After dealing 3 damage to the selected follower, that same selected follower should get [attack]+3; parsed incorrectly buffs self instead.

Missing passive ability: "During your turn, whenever this follower takes ability damage, give it [attack]+1 and Storm." This should be encoded as an onDamaged ability limited to your turn that checks ability damage, then buffs self and grants Storm. Engine needs support for an onDamaged trigger restricted to ability damage and/or controller turn only on a standalone card ability.
On Evolve is encoded incorrectly. Source says "discard a card" as a cost before the deck effect; parsed uses choose with no discard. It should require a discard cost, then resolve the deck search.

It should allow selecting up to 2 matching cards from the looked-at cards; engine needs support for search/top-of-deck choose-multiple with a max selection count.

Missing passive ability: "During your turn, whenever this follower takes ability damage, give it [attack]+1 and Storm." Engine needs support for an onDamaged trigger restricted to ability damage and/or controller turn only on a standalone card ability.

Keywords are incorrect. The source has no Fanfare keyword, so remove "fanfare" from keywords.
